name: Keith Gold
source: Founder and leader of the Keith Guild, for which [url=/c735]Rance[/url] works. Keith is the one who sent Rance on his mission to find [url=/c11982]Hikari[/url]. Keith isn't liked by Rance but the reward for the girl is something that the protagonist cannot refuse.
